episodeTitle.en: Making time for what matters | Jake Knapp and John Zeratsky (Authors of Make Time, Character VC)
episodeTitle.zh: 为重要之事腾出时间 | 杰克·纳普和约翰·泽拉斯基（《腾出时间》作者）

guestBioOfficial.en: Jake Knapp and John Zeratsky are bestselling authors of the books Sprint and Make Time. They have helped more than 300 teams design new products and bring them to market, including those at YouTube, Gusto, One Medical Group, and Slack. Jake and JZ are co-founders of the venture capital firm Character, where they support startups with capital and sprints. Previously, they were operating partners at Google Ventures and, before that, design leaders at Google, where JZ worked on Google Ads and YouTube and Jake helped build Gmail and co-founded Google Meet. In our conversation, we discuss: • “Busy bandwagon” and “infinity pools”
guestBioOfficial.zh:
杰克·纳普（Jake Knapp）和约翰·泽拉特斯基（John Zeratsky）是《冲刺》（Sprint）和《把握时间》（Make Time）两本书的畅销作者。他们曾帮助300多个团队设计新产品并将其推向市场，其中包括YouTube、Gusto、One Medical Group和Slack等公司。杰克和约翰是风险投资公司Character的联合创始人，通过资金和冲刺计划为初创企业提供支持。此前，他们曾在Google Ventures担任运营合伙人，更早之前则在谷歌担任设计主管，约翰曾参与Google Ads和YouTube的开发，杰克则协助开发Gmail并参与创立Google Meet。在对话中，我们探讨了以下内容：
• “忙碌的从众心理”和“无边泳池”

title.en: Making time for what matters | Jake Knapp and John Zeratsky (Authors of Make Time, Character VC)
title.zh: 为重要之事腾出时间 | 杰克·纳普和约翰·泽拉斯基（《腾出时间》作者）

summary.en: Jake and JZ focus on their book Make Time, arguing productivity is really about protecting one peak-attention moment a day—the 'highlight' you'd be proud to name at day's end—rather than time management. They share a ton of practical, immediately actionable tactics for product leaders and founders to spend their energy better and feel good about their days. The episode is a welcome, grounding counterpoint to hustle culture, and Lenny guarantees you'll leave with at least three things to change starting tomorrow.
summary.zh: Jake 和 JZ 聚焦他们的书《Make Time》，主张“生产力”真正关乎保护每天一段注意力巅峰的时刻——即你在一天结束时能骄傲地说出的“高光时刻”，而非时间管理。他们为产品领导者和创始人分享了大量可立刻落地、能更好分配精力并让日子过得更有成就感的实用方法。这期节目是对“拼搏文化”的一剂令人舒心的清醒剂，Lenny 保证你至少能带走三件明天就能改变的事。
